steps.content: You open the door, a gust of cold wind hits your face, making you shiver. On closer inspection, you find yourself in a snow-covered wilderness.
The snow-covered wilderness is pure and devoid of debris. Only a frail figure sits in the middle of the wilderness—it's Victoria.

Victoria sits on the snow, with her nose all red from the coldness. She touches the snow and mud without worry, even her bandages have been removed... It seems she no longer needs extra sterile protection.
A group of people in white scrubs surround her, softly singing to her.

steps.speaker: White Scrub A
steps.content: Misery, disease, jealousy, are all products of happiness...

steps.speaker: White Scrub B
steps.content: Happiness, freedom, dreams, are always hard to satisfy...
Suddenly, a deep male voice breaks the tranquility of the snowfield. He wears a mask, hiding his true face, and heads straight for Victoria.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: I'm back, Victoria... This is my promise to you, and it's also our bond of blood.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Dear Victoria, come with me. I have so many sceneries for you to behold.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Daddy! You came back from that world!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Sure, I'll follow you wherever you take me.
Victoria happily grabs the hand of the masked man. She grips it tightly, until blood flows out from her hand, turning into red sharp crystals that pierce the man's chest.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: ...As long as we never part. Anywhere you go, I'll be with you.
Victoria, with a face full of happiness, walks into the distance with the masked man whose body is covered in red crystals.
Suddenly, Victoria turns around, she notices your presence.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: You look... like you want to come with us too? Do you also want love and blessings?
She reaches out her hand to you, and the sharp crystals fly from her pale palm in your direction!
You quickly turn around and hide outside the door. You are not ready for these love and blessings by yourself.
